groups.problem: The worker-restart type check fails to recognize SpawnProcess instances, leaving old workers alive when replacements start.
groups.rationale: All three report the same guard skipping kill() during unhealthy-worker recovery. S6's reference to the identical shutdown check extends its proposed fix.

groups.problem: Expiration of the shared join deadline breaks out of the worker loop and skips cleanup of remaining workers.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same early break and require cleanup to continue after the waiting deadline expires. S8 mentions the spawn-compatible type check only within its proposed fix.
